# Hover

> Hover is the simplest way to send money across borders. Sign in with Google or Apple, choose an amount, and your money arrives in seconds.

Hover is **live now** as a web app at https://app.hover.money — sign in with a Google or Apple account and send money right away, nothing to install. Native iOS and Android apps are in development; from the marketing site (https://hover.money) visitors leave their email to be notified the day the app launches.

## Key facts

- No password: sign in with an existing Google or Apple account.
- Works in the browser at app.hover.money — nothing to download. Native iOS/Android apps are coming; an email early-access list is open.
- Transfers are typically delivered in seconds, any time of day, including weekends and holidays.
- Built for cross-border (international) payments; domestic transfers work too.
- Every transfer's fee is shown before you confirm — no hidden charges.
- Only the sender can approve a payment, and every transfer is protected end to end so it cannot be altered, reused, or redirected.
